stories.title: Dylan Sprouse: "Cole and I are children of incest"
stories.summary: On his Wildmen podcast, Dylan Sprouse explained that an Ancestry deep-dive showed his parents' families had intermarried during the Gold Rush, split, then "married again with my mom and my dad, like, last generation," and joked, "Long story short, Cole and I are children of incest." Headlines ran it straight, and X read it literally, though the two family lines actually meet generations back. Cole posted one to his Instagram Story: "No media training on earth can prep you to read this clickbait headline at 10am," and Dylan leaned in: "Ngl they cooked with this headline. Printing this out and hanging it over the communal family bed." A post of Cole's two Stories got 324K likes, TMZ's clip of the podcast 28K, and fans joked it was "literally a Riverdale plot."
